description:
Get a free personal token by email — for MCP clients that can't sign in themselves. Most clients (Claude,
    ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code) sign in to WeCookFlow with an email page instead: a request over the free
    limits makes them offer it. Signed in: up to 1,000 sites per comparison, 50 per search and paging through
    search results (up to 1,000 sites a day). No password.

    Ask the user for their email first — never invent one. The response contains the token and how to add it to
    the client's settings.

email.description: The user's email address — ask the user, never invent one.
